newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen officially requests to join Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC).

- Qatar is expected to launch an initiative to convince Bahrain to attend next week's GCC summit. Bahrain has accused Qatar of having an "unfriendly attitude" and said it would not take part in any GCC meetings held in Qatar.
- Kuwaiti General Investment Co is to organise a seminar about privatisation programmes.
- Gulf Arab states' oil income is expected to reach $90 billion in 1996 from $78 billion in 1995, according to a study by the Emirates Industrial Bank.
